D-027 supersedes D-020, so its complement is also six — D-017, D-019, D-021, D-022, D-023, D-024 — but its line reads 'does not change the other five contested predecessors'. Neither error changes an operative effect, since each entry supersedes exactly one correctly named predecessor and the seven-to-seven mapping across D-025 through D-031 is complete and bijective. But this corpus treats enumeration arithmetic as load-bearing — it is the class of C2-D017-02 and C2N1-D030-01 in this lineage — and both statements are false as written in entries whose premise is self-containment.

objections.claim: D-031's Lane R includes the freeze §3.1 item-to-supplier binding instrument and states that the lane starts with this entry, while the closing list states that these entries do not start the §3.1 instrument. A reader adopting D-031 cannot determine whether that work commences.
objections.evidence: Lane R reads: 'Lane R — standing authoritative Route A, starts now… The following list is non-exhaustive: … DR-008 evidence/retention join and Phase-1A insertion; the freeze §3.1 item-to-supplier binding instrument (D-001 Route A work; not a file-11 authority)… This lane starts with this entry, if adopted.' The closing list reads: 'Do not start the spike, the §3.1 instrument, or the language-quality corpus.' The tension is specific to this item rather than generic, because every other Lane R member is pre-existing in-flight V1 work whereas the §3.1 instrument does not exist and has not been commissioned — D-001's DR-004 route-A line, verified at COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, reads 'plus commission the missing §3.1-item-to-supplier binding instrument', so commissioning it is exactly what remains to be started. D-031's own accounting compounds the ambiguity: 'Item 7 (the §3.1 supplier-coverage instrument) is not a file-11 live-work item; it is standing Lane R / D-001 Route A work' — which places it inside the lane the entry starts. The draft is self-consistent on attribution and inconsistent only on commencement.
objections.proposedFix: Either drop the §3.1 instrument from the closing-list prohibition, since D-001 already assigns it to Route A and Lane R claims it, or add one clause to Lane R stating that commencement of the lane recognizes standing obligations and does not itself commission any instrument not already in flight, naming the §3.1 instrument as the case in point.

Third, the header asserts 'Every MUST-FIX and SHOULD-FIX accepted. Zero rebutted. Notes accepted', but C2N2-DRAFT-01's two items measure zero occurrences in these bytes: 'D-030 selects a scoped model' 0 matches, and 'over the register as it stands' 0 matches. Accepting a note and not landing it is lawful if disclosed; asserting acceptance while neither landing nor disclosing is the 'report ahead of bytes' class this corpus recorded as D-002 turn-3 OBS-T3-01. The review prompt directs that the disposition table is not evidence, and I treated it as none — this finding is about the artifact's own record, not about my verification, all of which was done against the decision text.

terminationNote: Turn 3 of 3. I CONSENT to D-025, D-028, D-029 and D-030 on the merits: each draws no finding at any severity, and I state affirmatively that I attacked each on every axis the prompt named and found nothing, rather than merely failing to look. I cannot consent to D-026, D-027 or D-031, each of which carries one SHOULD-FIX, and D-000 clause 2 forbids recording a forced consensus; under it those three park CONTESTED unless the other reviewer's independent verdict and the coordinator's disposition resolve them otherwise. I record two things for the coordinator's judgement, not as bargaining. First, no MUST-FIX survives anywhere in this draft — the last one was discharged this turn — and all three surviving objections are corrections of statements about the entries rather than of the decisions they make. Second, all three are single-clause repairs whose correct text I have supplied: two numerals and a range in the supersession disclaimers, one clause reconciling Lane R with the closing list, and one stale protocol line plus a refreshed disposition table. Whether that warrants a fresh dispatch, adoption of the four consented entries alone, or parking all seven is the coordinator's call under D-000, not mine.
